name: pod
description: Put what you build online on Pod and run it, on one or several Pod instances: deploy a ready-made image or a Git repository, follow deployments, read logs, set variables, add a database or a domain; podctx drives the pod CLI and the API per instance, with API keys kept in a password manager.

pod_url.title: Pod address
pod_url.description: The address of your Pod instance, without a trailing slash, e.g. https://pod.example.com
